/-- `InvMemClass S G` states `S` is a type of subsets `s ⊆ G` closed under inverses. -/
class InvMemClass (S : Type*) (G : outParam Type*) [Inv G] [SetLike S G] : Prop where
  /-- `s` is closed under inverses -/
  inv_mem : ∀ {s : S} {x}, x ∈ s → x⁻¹ ∈ s
